title: GZU: Practical Python for Self-Sufficiency (NOVA metal)
goal: Write clear Python that automates homestead/NOVA chores — files, data, schedules — with fundamentals solid enough to extend fieldkit tools without cargo-culting.

weeks.title: Python basics + why automate
weeks.objective: Run Python on local metal; expressions, types, and a first useful script.
weeks.activity: From S1 Ch.1 + S2 early chapters: print a host report (OS, cwd, python version) to a text file.
weeks.assessment: Script runs twice; output file exists; cites chapters used.

weeks.title: Flow control
weeks.objective: Branch and loop confidently (S1 Ch.2 / S2 control flow).
weeks.activity: Write a small CLI that validates a STEP filename pattern (STEP_*.md) and reports pass/fail.
weeks.assessment: Handles good and bad names without crashing.

weeks.title: Functions
weeks.objective: Factor code into functions with clear inputs/outputs (S1 Ch.3).
weeks.activity: Refactor week-2 script into functions; add a tiny unit-style self-check main.
weeks.assessment: Functions reusable; no copy-paste blocks left.

weeks.title: Lists and dictionaries
weeks.activity: Build an inventory dict for 5 AiTutor/NOVA paths (exists?, size) and pretty-print JSON.
weeks.assessment: JSON valid; missing paths marked honestly.

weeks.title: Strings and files
weeks.objective: Read/write text safely; organize files (S1 Ch.6, 8–9).
weeks.activity: Script that copies *.json course files to a backup folder with timestamps (no deletes).

weeks.title: Debugging and regex
weeks.objective: Debug calmly; extract patterns with regex (S1 Ch.7, 10).
weeks.activity: Parse PROOF: bytes=N lines from sample logs; unit-test edge cases.
weeks.assessment: Regex matches real PROOF lines; fails loudly on junk.

weeks.title: CSV, JSON, and documents
weeks.objective: Move tabular/structured data without Excel dependency (S1 Ch.12–14).
weeks.activity: Convert a small CSV of course weeks into course-json-shaped dicts; write pretty JSON.

weeks.title: Web data carefully
weeks.objective: Fetch public pages/APIs ethically (S1 Ch.11); prefer offline when possible.
weeks.activity: Fetch one allowlisted public page or local file URL; save text excerpt + timestamp (no scraping behind logins).
weeks.assessment: Citation of URL; no credentials; polite single request.

weeks.title: Scheduling and lightweight automation
weeks.objective: Time, schedule, launch programs (S1 Ch.15); know email/GUI chapters exist but keep HIL.
weeks.activity: Write a dry-run "node ping" script that timestamps and appends to a log (no SSH secrets).
weeks.assessment: Log lines append; dry-run never sends mail or moves mouse.

weeks.title: Capstone — NOVA chore bot
weeks.objective: Ship a small multi-file tool that helps AiTutor or fieldkit housekeeping.
weeks.activity: Capstone choices: (A) course JSON linter for built/*.json, (B) STAGING file inventory report, (C) PROOF line extractor. README cites S1/S2 chapters.
weeks.assessment: Runs on TUF; README with cites; no secrets in repo.

gaps: Practical Programming TOC only partially extracted — deepen week mapping from S2 when tutoring
ATBS 2015 edition — APIs (email/GUI) may be dated; prefer modern stdlib equivalents and flag gaps
tutor_notes: Adult GZU tone aimed at NOVA builders. Prefer local metal + HIL for mail/GUI automation. Pair with gzu-dscl for pipes. Cite S1/S2; never invent library APIs. Practice host: TUF or LinuxBox1 CPU Ollama for explaining code, not for secret handling.
nova_relevance: Directly supports fieldkit scripts, STEP/PROOF parsing, course JSON tooling, homestead inventories, and safe automation next to leash/HIL norms.
